title: A theoretically exact filtered back-propagation formula for single-time wave inversion

reasons: exact inversion formula for single-time wave data

summary_en: Derives an explicit filtered back-propagation formula for recovering an initial pressure field from single-time wave measurements. The paper identifies this inversion as the central reconstruction step in two-dimensional full-field photoacoustic projection imaging.

title: Untrained CNN and coefficient-space regularization for joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography
authors: Alfio Bozi; Anwesa Dey; Souvik Roy
matched_query: photoacoustic tomography joint initial pressure sound speed reconstruction untrained CNN
reasons: estimates initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed
metadata verified against the official arXiv record
summary_en: Combines fixed untrained CNN features, wavelet representations, Tikhonov regularization, and a learned coefficient-space prior to jointly reconstruct initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed from photoacoustic boundary measurements.

title: Photoacoustic imaging of human brain function through intact adult skulls
authors: Yilin Luo; Rui Cao; Manxiu Cui; Karteekeya Sastry; Kay Jann; Yousuf Aborahama; Geng Ku; Jinhua Xu; Xiaofei Luo; Shuai Na; Samuel Davis; Konstantin Maslov; Yang Zhang; Danny J. Wang; Lihong V. Wang

reports non-invasive transcranial functional PACT through intact adult skulls

summary_en: Demonstrates non-invasive transcranial functional photoacoustic computed tomography through intact adult skulls using a densely packed 3,072-element hemispherical ultrasound array, enabling single-shot volumetric acquisition at 20 Hz and task-evoked hemodynamic mapping in healthy adults.
